added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs on disk: after_suite (head-focus.log at 95f2cd4dba) records 58 passed with no FAILED line and baseline_suite (base-focus.log at 1d16388a) records 55 passed with no FAILED line, so the set difference is empty. Cross-checked over the wider admission-importing population the manifest also reports: base-admission.log at 1d16388a carries 165 distinct FAILED ids and head-admission.log at 95f2cd4dba carries 164; comm of the two id sets yields no id present at the head and absent at the base, and one id fixed.

findings.summary: the recorded-budget assertion cannot tell the caller's budget from the default
findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion compares launch_budget_seconds against BUDGET, the constant the test itself handed in, and BUDGET is 60.0 while DEFAULT_ADMISSION_PASS_BUDGET_SECONDS at reckon/flight.py:198 is also 60.0, so it holds even if admit_once ignored its budget_seconds argument and fell through to the flight default; it reddens only on total absence of the key. An independent check needs a budget that is not the default, such as 45.0, which would also be the only end-to-end exercise of the flight-config path.

findings.summary: a module-level config is mutated instead of copied
findings.text: non-blocking: the resolver binds config = fixtures.CONFIG and then writes the lane path into it, so the write lands on the module-level dict declared at tests/test_each_admission_pass_records_its_verdict.py:30 and survives into every later test in the same process that reads CONFIG without copying it; the existing owner is tests/test_each_admission_pass_records_its_verdict.py:140 _config_with_lane, which deep-copies at line 141, and this helper re-implements it minus the copy.

findings.summary: the profile artefact the done_when names is not in the file
findings.text: non-blocking: the node's done_when names the 120 s py-spy record --idle of the live admit service after landing as an artefact kept in this file; the section at lines 123-145 states the profile was not taken because the change is not landed and the restart belongs to the coordinator, so the absence is disclosed and a 93-pass verdict measurement stands in, but the named artefact is absent.

justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/admission/selection.py:316-325 reads one deadline and breaks the launch loop on it, and selection.py:771-788 puts launch_seconds and slowest_step on every launched row, matching the goal exactly.
